paragraphs.text: Ziva is a Vodalian merfolk on Dominaria , who was hired by Jhoira to find and recover the Weatherlight .

Ziva is characterized by her striking natural armor that exhibits deep purples and blues on her arms and flanks. Her powerful tail, adept at propelling her swiftly through the water, enhances her aquatic agility.

Ziva is confident and efficient, able to assess situations underwater quickly. She demonstrates a cheerful and optimistic demeanor, shown by her bubbly laughter and positive attitude, even when dealing with potentially challenging tasks. Her interactions suggest a pragmatic approach, valuing clear agreements and fair compensation.

Ziva played a crucial role in retrieving the remnants of the great skyship Weatherlight . Tasked with locating and raising the wreck from the ocean floor, she successfully navigated the challenges of saltweed and sand entanglements, ensuring the hull was freed from the seabed. Her leadership and coordination with other merfolk were instrumental in accomplishing this feat within the promised time frame, thereby earning doubled payment and contributing significantly to the restoration efforts of the historic vessel.
